name: Namakemon
main_effect: [On Play] [When Digivolving] If you have 3 or more security cards, until the end of your opponent's turn, 1 of your Digimon can't have its DP reduced by your opponent's effects and isn't affected by ＜De-Digivolve＞ effects. If you have 3 or fewer, 1 of your Digimon gains ＜Blocker＞ (This Digimon can block in the blocker timing.) and ＜Reboot＞ (Unsuspend this Digimon during your opponent's unsuspend phase.) until the end of your opponent's turn.
source_effect: [All Turns] While this Digimon has [Pulsemon] in its text, it gets +1000 DP.
